title: RAW UNREVIEWED: repeated plant drawings carry a preparation-role graph across Herbal and pharmacy registers
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. The source-native SNPL001 inventory preserves four human-described same-plant Herbal-to-pharmaceutical drawing relations with distinct labelled fragments. Earlier GDT352 and FPR001 do not support exact-surface, shared-family or ordered-root name recovery; preserve those failures. A different semantic architecture would ask whether a full Herbal article introduces a pictured material and a later pharmaceutical fragment records a derived part or preparation of that same material. For each fixed source-owned pair, freeze the complete permitted Herbal passage and local pharmaceutical record; independently identify the depicted organ or product before matching words. The derived-material account predicts an explicit ingredient-to-product relation and consistent role order in the full passages, while a mere taxonomic index predicts plant identity references without a required operation/product chain. One attractive pair does not suffice: all four source-owned relations, the f99r/f96v exact-form counterexample, and any unowned labels stay in scope. The missing input is an independently readable part or process and a legitimate text-to-illustration relation; no name, process or lexeme is asserted now.

design.mechanism: one pictured biological referent changes discourse role from whole plant article to labelled fragment or preparation record
design.unit: the four SNPL001 source-owned Herbal-to-pharmacy pairs, each with complete already permitted text and image-local record
design.contrast: derived-material/process graph versus same-plant taxonomic cross-reference versus unrelated formulaic entries
design.prediction: A process account must recover both same-referent continuity and a directed part/product operation in the complete text; a taxonomic account needs continuity but not a directed operation; an unrelated-entry account permits neither. Literal name-root similarity alone is not scored as meaning.
design.missing_input: independent organ or preparation identification and an author-visible text-to-drawing owner for each pair
